name: Open Mic
name_note: Renamed from the placeholder Jukeoke by the owner on 2026-11-22 (DECISIONS D-253). Internal identifiers (crate and package names, jukeoke-cli, the bundle id, the .jksong magic) keep the old name on purpose. Check for conflicts before any public release.
song_magic_note: The song file magic bytes are NOT renamed with the app; see docs/SONG_FORMAT.md.
tagline: Karaoke from any song, on a bubbler jukebox.
also_edit_note: Files that spell the name (or the bundle id, or the jukeoke-cli tool name) as a literal, so a rename is a manual edit there. Read from this file at build or run time, so NOT listed: the UI page title and badge (vite.config.ts injects the name into app/ui/index.html; AppInfo.name), the Studio's song provenance and its LRCLIB User-Agent when branding.json is beside it. Left out on purpose: comments, docs/, README/CONTRIBUTING/MODELS/THIRD_PARTY files, test fixtures, and internal identifiers that users never see and that need not change with the name (crate jukeoke, Python package jukeoke_studio, JUKEOKE_* environment variables, CSS classes, the .jksong magic). Re-check with: grep -rIl Jukeoke --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=target --exclude-dir=docs .
also_edit: app/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json  (productName, mainBinaryName, identifier, bundle publisher; build.rs fails the build if the first three disagree with this file)
app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml       (package and bin name 'jukeoke' only if the binary should be renamed; description)

app/src-tauri/src/core.rs, error.rs, lib.rs, startup.rs, recorder.rs, selfcheck.rs, testsong.rs, commands/app.rs  (user-facing messages, the native start-up dialog title, the self-check's test song artist and provenance name)
app/src-tauri/src/portable.rs  (macOS: the remembered-root folder ~/Library/Application Support/org.jukeoke.app and its 'jukeoke' fallback; keep in step with bundle_id)

crates/jk-cli/src/main.rs      (#[command(name = "jukeoke-cli", about = "Jukeoke ...")]; a new tool name also needs scripts/ci-render.sh, studio/tests/test_server.py (_cli) and studio/bench/e2e_metrics.py)
crates/jk-format/src/error.rs  (messages 'not a Jukeoke song file', 'a newer version of Jukeoke')
crates/jk-recorder/src/lib.rs and src/platform/macos/mod.rs  (Screen Recording permission texts; optionally the Objective-C class names JukeokeRecorder* and the org.jukeoke.recorder.* queue labels)
studio/jukeoke_studio/lyrics.py  (default_user_agent: fallback name used when branding.json is not beside the Studio, e.g. the packaged runtime)
studio/jukeoke_studio/jksong.py  (messages 'not a Jukeoke song file', 'a newer version of Jukeoke')
studio/jukeoke_studio/modelzoo/download.py  (USER_AGENT 'jukeoke-studio/0.1' for model downloads; the 'the one Jukeoke was tested with' detail)
studio/pyproject.toml          (description; the distribution name jukeoke-studio only if the package is renamed, then also scripts/build-studio-runtime.sh)
app/ui/src/api/mock.ts         (the browser mock's AppInfo.name, seen in screenshots made with the mock)
scripts/gen-third-party.sh     (names of the shipped binaries and the app's licence paragraph in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md)
scripts/user-dirs-audit.py, app/scripts/portable-smoke-test.sh  (the 'jukeoke' search pattern of the portable-mode audit)
